title: Billing and entitlement client: fetch, cache, gate, upgrade links
goal: Fetch, cache and expose workspace entitlements so every feature gate in the client reads one source of truth, with correct refresh triggers, offline behaviour and upgrade paths, and never gates LAN or local use.
scope_in: Fetch `GET /v1/workspaces/{id}/entitlements` (object with `rev`, `plan`, `status`, `period`, `limits`, `usage`, `warnings`, `grace_until`), validate with the C003 schema, cache in memory and on disk (non-secret, `<state dir>/entitlements/<wsp>.json`).

Freshness rules (CT-ENTITLEMENTS §6): cache TTL 5 minutes; refetch when the access token's `ent` claim differs from the cached `rev` (subscribe to the C052 `ent-changed` event), on `sys.notice plan_changed`, and on `403`/`429` errors whose code starts with `entitlement_`; offline: serve last known value for display for up to 24 h, flagged `stale`.

Gate API: `can(key)`, `limit(key)`, `remaining(key)`, `statusBanner()` mapping `past_due` (grace 7 days via `grace_until`), `canceled` (until `period.end`), `none`; `warnings[]` (80 % threshold) and `quota_reached` notices turned into UI events.

Billing reads/actions: GET /v1/plans (public), GET .../subscription, GET .../invoices (paginated), GET .../usage/summary, POST .../checkout (Idempotency-Key required) -> `{url}`, POST .../portal -> `{url}`, PATCH .../seats (`?preview=true` proration preview), POST .../coupons/redeem; return URLs for the caller to open (`centcom://billing` / https://centcom.dev/billing fallbacks).
Upgrade-link helper: `upgradeUrl(reason)` returning the checkout/portal URL via the API and opening it through an injected opener; no card data ever touched.
Unknown limit keys: displayed generically, never used to unlock features.
scope_out: Server-side enforcement (the client mirrors for UI only, CT-ENTITLEMENTS §2 'Enforced by').
Billing UI screens: TUI lanes and the web billing UI (lane C089).
Reporting usage: lane C065. Receiving WS notices: lane C057 re-emits them; this lane only reacts.
Stripe or payment state of any kind: the client never reads it (entitlements only).
build_against: the mock backend (lane C007): REST from OpenAPI plus the WebSocket relay simulator, started in-process with `startMockBackend()` from @centcom/testkit; no real backend is needed. The mock serves entitlements for free/pro/team using contracts/fixtures/entitlements/*.json (including past_due, canceled and warnings states), increments `rev` on demand (`mock.bumpEntitlements()`), and returns checkout/portal URLs.
interfaces: `new EntitlementsClient(o: { http: HttpClient; auth: Pick<TokenManager, 'claims' | 'on'>; workspaceId: () => string | null; clock; cacheDir: string; opener?: (url: string) => Promise<boolean> })`
`get(o?: { force?: boolean }): Promise<EntitlementsView>`; `EntitlementsView = { ent: Entitlements; fetchedAt: string; stale: boolean; source: 'network'|'cache' }`

`can(key: 'relay_access'|'lan_multiplayer'|...): boolean | 'unknown'`, `limit(key): number | boolean | null | undefined`, `remaining(key: 'agent_minutes_month'|'tokens_month'|'queue_items_month'): number | null`, `banner(): { kind: 'none'|'past_due'|'canceled'|'quota_warning'|'quota_reached'; pct?: number; graceUntil?: string; periodEnd?: string }`
`onChange(fn: (e: EntitlementsView) => void): () => void`; `noticeHandler(n: Notice): void` (wire to session notices)

`billing = { plans(), subscription(wsp), invoices(wsp): AsyncIterable<Invoice>, usageSummary(wsp), checkout(wsp, o: { plan: string; seats?: number; currency?: 'USD'|'EUR' }): Promise<{ url: string }>, portal(wsp), previewSeats(wsp, seats), setSeats(wsp, seats), redeemCoupon(wsp, code) }`
acceptance: `get()` twice within 5 minutes (fake clock) makes one network call; after 5 min + 1 s the third call refetches; `get({force:true})` always refetches.
When the access token's `ent` claim changes from 42 to 43, the next `get()` refetches immediately even inside the 5 minute window.
A `sys.notice plan_changed {plan:'team'}` triggers a refetch within 1 s and `onChange` fires with the new plan; a 429 whose code starts `entitlement_` also triggers one refetch.

With the mock stopped, `get()` returns the last cached value with `stale:false` for the first 5 min, `stale:true` afterwards, and keeps serving it up to 24 h; after 24 h it returns `ent.status:'none'` defaults flagged `stale` and still never throws for display callers.
`can('lan_multiplayer')` is true with no cache, no login and no network; `can('relay_access')` is false for the free fixture and true for pro; an unknown key returns `'unknown'` and is never `true`.
`past_due` fixture: `banner()` is `past_due` with `graceUntil`; entitlements remain unchanged until `grace_until`, then are treated as `none`; `canceled` keeps limits until `period.end`.
With `warnings:[{limit:'agent_minutes_month', pct:80}]` an `onChange` carries the warning, `remaining()` equals `limit - usage`, and `tokens_month: null` yields `remaining() === null` (unlimited).

`checkout()` sends one POST with an `Idempotency-Key`, a retried call reuses it, and the returned URL is opened only when the caller invokes the opener; the URL must be https or the call fails with `InvalidUrlError`.
`previewSeats()` calls PATCH with `?preview=true` and changes nothing in the cache; `setSeats()` triggers a forced refetch.
No entitlement or invoice data is logged beyond plan name, rev and status; cache file contains no tokens.
tests: billing/cache.test.ts: TTL, ent-claim change, notice, 429 trigger, 24 h offline on a fake clock.
billing/gates.test.ts: every limit key for free/pro/team fixtures; unknown key; null = unlimited; status banner matrix.
billing/api.test.ts: idempotency header on checkout, preview vs commit seats, coupon errors mapped to typed errors.
billing/lan-free.test.ts: gates answer correctly with no HTTP client at all.
billing/schema.test.ts: all contracts/fixtures/entitlements/*.json validate and are accepted; extra unknown fields ignored.
guardrails: MUST NOT read, infer or store Stripe, card or price-plan internals to decide access; decisions use entitlement keys only (CT-ENTITLEMENTS intro).
MUST NEVER gate LAN or local use on entitlements or network state; `lan_multiplayer` is always true and not fetched.
MUST treat unknown limit keys as display-only and MUST NOT use them to unlock a feature.
MUST NOT trust the cache for hosted-action authorisation: gates are advisory, the server enforces (a stale cache saying true never bypasses the server).
MUST NOT open any URL that is not https (or the configured dev base) and MUST NOT log checkout/portal URLs (they carry session tokens).
MUST use Idempotency-Key on checkout, portal, seats and coupon POST/PATCH calls as CT-API-BILLING marks them.
failure_modes: Entitlements 403 (not a member) -> clear cache for that workspace and return free defaults with a typed `NotAMemberError`.
Schema validation of the response fails -> keep the previous cache, raise `ContractViolationError`, log request_id only.
Workspace switch -> cache keyed per workspace id; a pending fetch for the old workspace is discarded.
Disk cache unreadable -> ignore and refetch; never block startup.
notes: CONTRACT GAP: the error codes for entitlement denials (`entitlement_*`) and the checkout request body fields (plan, seats, currency) live only in errors.json/openapi.yaml; the card follows those files. Quota behaviour at 100 % blocks only hosted work server-side; this lane only informs the UI.
